kpis.description: Principal driver of net sales growth and profitability. Metric tracked annually by company analysts, with historical data over past 5 years.

kpis.name: New stores opened
kpis.explanation: Number of new stores opened during the period
kpis.description: Key indicator of organic expansion strategy and acquisitions, combining backfilling and entry into new contiguous markets

kpis.name: Comparable store sales growth
kpis.explanation: Sales variation from stores open for at least 16 full months
kpis.description: Measure of organic performance of existing stores, key indicator of acceleration versus FY2024 (2.8%)

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin expressed as percentage of net sales
kpis.description: Indicator of profitability and efficiency of opportunistic sourcing model, improving from 40.3% in FY2024

kpis.name: Net sales

kpis.name: Net income

kpis.name: Average net sales per store

risks.title: Dependence on growth through store openings
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned at beginning of strategy section with strong language ('biggest driver'). Increasing trend: 86 stores opened in 2025 versus 50 in 2024, with pre-opening expenses up 30.9%. Industry category moderately weighted but growth is explicit primary driver of model.

risks.title: Sensitivity to discretionary spending
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly stated mid-section with moderate language ('may be impacted'). Detailed enumeration of macroeconomic factors (wages, energy, rates, inflation, housing). Trend stable but current inflationary context increases relevance. Macro category heavily weighted for retailer.

risks.title: Intensification of competition
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned mid-section with moderate language ('could impact'). Potential consolidation of competitors identified as uncertainty factor. Trend stable but retail landscape in flux. Competition category heavily weighted but mitigated by unique price positioning.

risks.title: Increase in supply chain costs
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in results section with explicit language ('higher supply chain costs, including incremental tariff expense'). Increasing trend: gross margins impacted by additional tariffs in 2025. Positioned mid-report. Industry category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Risks related to store acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified in growth strategy with explicit mention of bankruptcy acquisitions. Increasing trend: 63 of 86 stores opened in 2025 from bankruptcies with 'dark rent' of $5.2M. Positioned early-to-mid. Industry category moderately weighted.

risks.title: Construction delays and permitting
risks.score_rationale: Risk explicitly mentioned at end of liquidity section with moderate language ('may continue to experience'). Trend stable but recognized as recurring issue. Positioned at end of report. Regulation category heavily weighted but impact limited to date.
